content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD infrastructure source 11개를 전수 읽어 boundary/ghosts, initialization, MPI decomposition, input/output, initial waves, statistics/nesting/misc, global/parameter/input-parser state를 연결한 노트이다(1-50행). main에서 READ_INPUT, INDEX, allocation/initialization, timestep boundary/exchange/coupling/safety, statistics/station/field output으로 이어지는 call flow를 제시한다(52-61행).
entities: bc.F boundary flux, exchange, PHI_COLL and variable-length ghost routines (lines 14-18)
parallel.F real/integer exchange and global-array distribution (lines 25-28)
io.F OUTPUT, READ_INPUT, PREVIEW, STATIONS, GetFile, PutFile (lines 30-34)
samples.F solitary, Gaussian, rectangular, dipole and N-wave initial conditions (lines 36-38)
misc.F Cartesian topology, CFL, extrema, blowup and Shapiro filter (lines 43-45)

params_defined.name: verification_method
params_defined.default: full read of 11 infrastructure source files

io.name: eta_00001 and OUT_* fields through PutFile
time, eta, u, v ASCII buffers

calls: EXCHANGE conditionally calls SHAPIRO_3 after ghost exchange (line 16)
INITIALIZATION calls PHI_COLL, bathy correction, initial-wave routines, wavemaker, sponge, masks and coupling (line 22)
OUTPUT dispatches STATISTICS, PREVIEW, stations and feature counters (line 31)
PREVIEW calls PutFile; GetFile performs parallel distribution (lines 33-34)
STATISTICS calls CHECK_STATISTICS and MPI_ABORT on NaN (line 41)
unresolved: statistics energy includes 0.5*g*H^2 and only u^2 kinetic energy (line 41). In a 2-D model the v^2 H term is absent from the stated expression, suggesting a component omission or incomplete transcription.

CFL denominator is written |U+c| and |V+c| (line 44), not |U|+c and |V|+c. Counter-propagating velocity U=-c would make the written denominator zero and timestep unbounded; exact source parentheses must be checked.
MUSCL kappa selection maps SEC to -1 and every other value to 1/3 (line 22). No validation branch is described, so misspelled/unknown scheme names may silently select the latter coefficient.
SHAPIRO_3 coefficient is written a1=44/64 (line 45). If the source operands are integer literals, Fortran integer division yields zero before assignment; literal kinds or casts are not shown.

CHECK_STATISTICS aborts on NaN and CHECK_BLOWUP aborts when |Eta| exceeds a threshold (lines 41,45). Positive/negative infinity in non-Eta fields and invalid H/U/V values below the Eta threshold are not stated as checked.

DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob is described as MPI_ISEND distribution but matching receives, request storage, WAIT completion, and PHIGLOB buffer lifetime are not included (line 28). The nonblocking interface ordering cannot be verified from this note.

BOUNDARY_CONDITION uses variable spelling `Deps` in the flux expression (line 15), whereas global depth state is named Depth/H/Depthx/Depthy (line 48). Whether Deps is a declared boundary depth or a copy typo is unresolved.
